name: ASTACUS FLUVIATILIS
skin_symptoms: Nettle-rash over whole body. Itching. Crusta lactea, with enlarged lymphatic glands. Erysipelas, and liver affections with nettle-rash. Swelling of cervical glands. Jaundice.
fever_symptoms: Inward chilliness; very sensitive to air, worse uncovering; violent fever, with headache.

source.title: ASTACUS FLUVIATILIS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
